SELECT COUNT(*) AS participants, COALESCE(SUM(team_id IS NOT NULL),0) AS teamedParticipants, COALESCE(SUM(team_id IS NULL),0) AS unteamedParticipants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team WHERE event_id=#{eventId}) AS teams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team t JOIN event e ON e.event_id=t.event_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r WHERE r.team_id=t.team_id)<COALESCE(e.team_min_size,1)) AS underfilledTeams FROM registration WHERE event_id=#{eventId}

mapper.select: SELECT p.phase_id AS phaseId,p.name AS phaseName,t.track_id AS trackId,t.name AS trackName, p.submit_beg AS submitBeg,p.submit_end AS submitEnd,p.review_end AS reviewEnd, () AS denominatorAvailable, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team tm LEFT JOIN submission s ON s.team_id=tm.team_id AND s.phase_id=p.phase_id WHERE tm.track_id=t.track_id AND ) AS knownExpectedTeams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission s WHERE s.phase_id=p.phase_id) AS submittedTeams, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submission s WHERE s.phase_id=p.phase_id AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM review_assignment a WHERE a.submission_id=s.submission_id AND a.status IN(0,1))) AS unassignedWorks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_assignment a WHERE a.phase_id=p.phase_id AND a.status=0) AS pendingTasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_assignment a WHERE a.phase_id=p.phase_id AND a.status=1) AS doneTasks FROM phase p JOIN track t ON t.track_id=p.track_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} ORDER BY t.track_id,p.submit_beg,p.phase_id

SELECT a.phase_id AS phaseId,p.name AS phaseName,a.judge_id AS judgeId,u.name AS judgeName, SUM(a.status=0) AS pending,SUM(a.status=1) AS done,SUM(a.status IN(0,1)) AS total, SUM(a.status=0 AND p.review_end<#{now}) AS overdue FROM review_assignment a JOIN user u ON u.user_id=a.judge_id JOIN phase p ON p.phase_id=a.phase_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id=p.track_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} GROUP BY a.phase_id,p.name,a.judge_id,u.name ORDER BY a.phase_id,a.judge_id

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_assignment a JOIN phase p ON p.phase_id=a.phase_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id=p.track_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} AND ) AS unreplacedRecusals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_flag f JOIN phase p ON p.phase_id=f.phase_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id=p.track_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} AND f.status=0 AND f.supplement_end>#{now}) AS openFlags, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_flag f JOIN phase p ON p.phase_id=f.phase_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id=p.track_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} AND ) AS expiredFlags

choose.when: SELECT r.user_id AS userId,u.name,r.track_id AS trackId FROM registration r JOIN user u ON u.user_id=r.user_id WHERE r.event_id=#{eventId} AND r.team_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.user_id

SELECT tm.team_id AS teamId,tm.name,tm.track_id AS trackId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r WHERE r.team_id=tm.team_id) AS members FROM team tm JOIN event e ON e.event_id=tm.event_id WHERE tm.event_id=#{eventId} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r WHERE r.team_id=tm.team_id)<COALESCE(e.team_min_size,1) ORDER BY tm.team_id

SELECT a.assignment_id AS assignmentId,a.phase_id AS phaseId,a.submission_id AS submissionId, a.judge_id AS judgeId,u.name AS judgeName,p.review_end AS reviewEnd FROM review_assignment a JOIN user u ON u.user_id=a.judge_id JOIN phase p ON p.phase_id=a.phase_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id=p.track_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} AND p.phase_id=#{phaseId} AND a.status=0AND ORDER BY a.assignment_id
choose.otherwise: SELECT f.flag_id AS flagId,f.phase_id AS phaseId,f.submission_id AS submissionId,f.description, f.supplement_end AS supplementEnd,f.status,f.close_reason AS closeReason FROM review_flag f JOIN phase p ON p.phase_id=f.phase_id JOIN track t ON t.track_id=p.track_id WHERE t.event_id=#{eventId} AND p.phase_id=#{phaseId} AND f.status=0 AND f.supplement_end>#{now}AND ORDER BY f.flag_id
